09.03.05.15 An invention which in effect, is traditional knowledge or which 
is an aggregation or duplication of known properties of 
traditionally known component or components is not an 
invention. 
Traditional Knowledge, be ing knowledge already existing, is not 
patentable. An example is the antiseptic properties of turmeric for 
wound healing. Another example is the pesticidal and insecticidal 
properties of neem. 
The Examiner conducts investigation by using Traditional Knowle dge
